query: The trace output says formatting finished and closed the data set — what should I look at next?
answer_text: AHL125I reports that the generalized trace facility finished formatting the requested trace records and closed the output data set. Review the formatted listing for the event sequence that precedes this message.
note: De-anchored: no message ID in the query; the page carries it. Sibling doc shares trace vocabulary.

query: During trace startup the operator saw AHL127A asking for options — which replies are valid?
answer_text: AHL127A prompts the operator to supply trace options before formatting begins. Valid replies are U for installation defaults, N for no options, or an explicit option string as documented for the prompt.
note: Anchored control: ID in query pins the lexical path. Sibling trap held in calibration.

query: What does AHL126I indicate when it appears in the middle of a GTF listing?
answer_text: AHL126I marks a discontinuity in the trace record sequence, normally caused by records lost when the trace buffer wrapped before formatting. Restart the trace with a larger buffer if the gap hides the failure window.
note: Anchored control mirroring PAR-02 across the sibling book.

query: Which manual documents the members processed during system start?
answer_text: The z/OS MVS Initialization and Tuning Reference describes every IEASYSxx member, their parameters, and the order in which initialization applies them during IPL.

query: Operators need more real storage for paging — which setting grows the area used for large pages?
answer_text: The LFAREA parameter in IEASYSxx controls the size of the large frame area used for 64-bit backed pages. Increase its value and re-IPL for the new size to take effect.
note: De-anchored: no IEASYSxx/LFAREA/64-bit in the query; bridges large pages to large frame area.

query: How do I get a started task to come up on its own after a reboot?
answer_text: A COMMNDxx entry issues operator commands automatically at initialization. Code COM='S procname' on its own line to start a task, where procname names the cataloged procedure to be started.
note: De-anchored: reboot for IPL, no member/commands wording; pattern stays the verbatim anchor.

query: Security wants another library programs can only run from if authorized — which parmlib entry grants that?
answer_text: The PROGxx APF ADD statement authorizes a library. Code APF ADD DSNAME=library.name VOLUME=volser to add the named data set on the named volume to the authorized program facility list.
note: Same member doc as PAR-06, different section: intra-doc discrimination.

query: A batch sort keeps spilling and runs for hours — where is the overflow going and what relieves it?
answer_text: When DFSORT exhausts in-storage sort work space it spills intermediate runs to SORTWK data sets. Check that enough SORTWK volumes are allocated and consider raising the storage available to the sort before rerunning.
note: De-anchored: no SORTWK/work-data-sets wording in the query.

query: Where are the sort product's job control verbs documented?
answer_text: The DFSORT Application Programming Guide documents every control statement, including SORT, MERGE, OPTION, and OUTFIL, with the syntax rules for each.

query: Our shop still runs the older spool manager — is it supported on current releases?
answer_text: JES2 remains a supported job entry subsystem. The JES2 initialization statements reference documents the statements valid for the current release; JES3 entries are retained only for migration reference.
note: De-anchored: no JES2/subsystem wording in the query.

query: To let someone read a data set, do I change who they are grouped with or the data set's own list?
answer_text: Use the PERMIT command to grant data set access to users or groups; use CONNECT to attach a user to a group. PERMIT changes the access list while CONNECT changes group membership.
note: De-anchored: no PERMIT/CONNECT/grant/access wording in the query.

query: How do spool volume definitions change when a second MAS member joins?
answer_text: A SPOOLDEF initialization statement defines the spool volumes each member formats. In a multi-member MAS every member must format the same spool volumes, while a single member may use a private spool configuration.
note: De-anchored: no SPOOLDEF/JES2 wording; same JES2 doc as PAR-10.

query: A transaction died on our terminal screen and CICS took over — what should we check?
answer_text: DFHAC2007 indicates the transaction abended and CICS abnormal-termination processing took over the terminal. Check the dump data set for the abend code and correct the program error before retrying.
note: De-anchored: no message ID in the query; vendor-shaped ID outside MSG_RE.

query: The control region says startup finished — can we start sending it work?
answer_text: DFS0536I signals that IMS initialization completed and the control region is ready to accept work. If dependent regions have not started, verify their JCL before submitting transactions.

query: How do I define the signaling paths our sysplex members use to talk to each other?
answer_text: COUPLExx defines the XCF signalling paths between sysplex members. Code PATHIN and PATHOUT statements naming the channel and CTC devices that carry cross-system coupling traffic.
note: Competitor doc: shares IEASYSxx/init vocabulary with SA22-8001-00.

query: The clock is drifting between LPARs — where do I set the time zone offset?
answer_text: CLOCKxx sets the system time zone and enables timer synchronization. Code TIMEZONE=hh:mm with the offset west of UTC, plus ETRMODE for timer connectivity.
note: Same competitor doc as PAR-17, different section.

query: The system dumped but the capture area was too small — where do I enlarge it?
answer_text: DIAGxx controls dump capture options. Code TRDUMP with MAXSPACE=n to enlarge the dump data set allocation for SVC dumps and stand-alone dumps.
note: Competitor doc: shares init/dump vocabulary with SA22-8001-00.

query: I keep retyping the same long data set names in parmlib — can I define shortcuts?
answer_text: IEASYMxx defines static system symbols. Code SYSDEF SYMDEF('name'='value') to create a symbol, then reference &name anywhere a data set name appears.
note: Competitor doc: shares parmlib/member/statement vocabulary with SA23-1395-70.

query: I have two already-sorted files — how do I combine them without sorting again?
answer_text: The MERGE control statement combines presorted data sets. Code MERGE FIELDS=(key spec) with SORTIN01 and SORTIN02 pointing at the input files.
note: Competitor doc: shares DFSORT/sort vocabulary with SC23-6901-70.

query: We are finally migrating off JES3 — what covers the conversion steps?
answer_text: The JES3 to JES2 migration guide covers converting JES3 initialization statements to their JES2 equivalents. Migrate spool definitions first, then converter and FSS definitions.
